segments.name: Digital Asset Treasury
segments.description: Acquires, holds and stakes Solana tokens as its digital asset treasury, while also running a smaller neurotechnology business focused on neurological wellness.
segments.evidence: therefore, the Company has a single reporting segment and the determination of the single segment is consistent with the information provided to the CODM.

revenueModel.text: Validator service providers pay in staking rewards for access to delegated SOL, while patients, an e-commerce partner and clinics pay for product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: the Company provides the validator service providers with the right to use its delegated SOL in exchange for noncash consideration in the form of protocol-generated staking.

changes.text: In 2025 the company adopted a digital asset treasury strategy centered on acquiring SOL and repositioned a substantial portion of its balance sheet around it.
changes.evidence: In September 2025, we adopted a digital asset treasury strategy centered on acquiring SOL and began repositioning a substantial portion of our balance sheet around that strategy.
